rows.verified: The Environment Agency takes up to twenty samples at each designated bathing water between May and September.
Annual classifications use measurements collected over a period of up to four years.
A Poor classification triggers advice against bathing, but the beach itself may remain open.
Pollution-risk forecasts use weather, tide and related data and do not specifically identify sewage as the contamination source.
The 2025 England snapshot reported 449 classified sites, 417 at Sufficient or above, 297 Excellent and 32 Poor.

rows.source: Ofgem plan for a power cut
rows.verified: Power cuts commonly result from network damage such as storm damage or planned maintenance and improvement work.

rows.source: Ofgem plan for a power cut
rows.verified: Power cuts should be reported to the electricity network operator responsible for local wires.

rows.source: Ofgem plan for a power cut
rows.verified: Ofgem directs consumers to the Powercut 105 service to find their electricity network operator.

rows.source: Ofgem plan for a power cut
rows.verified: Loss of power caused by a faulty meter should be reported to the energy supplier rather than the network operator.

rows.source: Ofgem plan for a power cut
rows.verified: Households relying on electricity for medical reasons should tell both their network operator and supplier.

rows.source: Ofgem plan for a power cut
rows.verified: People using powered medical equipment are advised to check whether it has a backup battery and how long it lasts.

rows.source: Ofgem plan for a power cut
rows.verified: Businesses are advised to tell their electricity network operator about operational circumstances relevant to an outage.

rows.source: Ofgem plan for a power cut
rows.verified: Network operators may support critical circumstances during a cut, including provision of backup generators in some cases.
Both energy suppliers and network operators maintain Priority Services Registers.
Priority Services Register support can include priority help during an emergency.
Where possible, registered consumers may receive advance notice of scheduled power cuts.
The register can provide an identification and password scheme for visits or contacts.
A trusted nominee can receive communications and bills on the consumer's behalf.
Support can include moving a prepayment meter when the consumer cannot safely reach it.
Account information and bills may be provided in large print or braille.
